title: Robust Inference for Weighted Estimands
abstract: arXiv:2607.07524v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Researchers often conduct inference on weighted estimands, defined as weighted averages of group-level effects. Example settings include event studies with cohort-level effects and experiments with site-level effects. Under heterogeneous effects, different weighting schemes yield estimands with distinct empirical and policy interpretations, leading to ambiguity and disagreement over the choice of weights. I establish bounds on differences between weighted estimands and confidence bounds on effect heterogeneity, which I use to construct estimators that minimize worst-case bias and confidence intervals that are uniformly valid over classes of weighted estimands. I apply these methods to an event study in Lakdawala, Nakasone, and Kho (2023), which studies the effects of school-based internet access on test scores. I find that results are robust to broad classes of weights. I then apply the methods to Tennessee's Project STAR experiment

translated_title: 加权估计量的稳健推断
translated_abstract: 研究人员经常对加权估计量进行推断，加权估计量被定义为群体层面效应的加权平均值。典型场景包括具有队列层面效应的事件研究以及具有地点层面效应的实验。在效应存在异质性的情况下，不同的加权方案会产生具有不同实证和政策解释的估计量，从而导致在权重选择上的模糊性与分歧。我建立了加权估计量之间差异的界限以及效应异质性的置信界限，并利用这些界限构建了最小化最坏情况偏差的估计量，以及在各类加权估计量上一致有效的置信区间。我将这些方法应用于Lakdawala、Nakasone和Kho（2023）的一项事件研究，该研究考察了学校互联网接入对考试成绩的影响，发现结果对广泛的权重类别具有稳健性。随后，我将这些方法应用于田纳西州STAR项目实验。
tldr: 本文针对效应异质性下权重选择引发的模糊性问题，提出了通过建立加权估计量差异界限与效应异质性置信界限，来构建最小化最坏情况偏差的估计量及对各类加权估计量一致有效的置信区间的稳健推断方法。
en_tdlr: This paper develops robust inference methods for weighted estimands by establishing bounds on differences between weighted estimands and confidence bounds on effect heterogeneity, thereby constructing estimators that minimize worst-case bias and confidence intervals that are uniformly valid across classes of weighted estimands.
